title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM & DSPM for AI)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: See and reduce your data-security risk — including AI/Copilot exposure
problem: You can't reduce data risk you can't see — and generative AI (Copilot) makes over-shared, unlabeled data newly dangerous. This solution implements Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) in Purview: the DSPM overview and recommendations, surfacing sensitive-data risk across the estate, and DSPM for AI — visibility into what AI/Copilot can access, prompts/responses touching sensitive data, and the policies to reduce oversharing before and during AI adoption — so data-security posture is measured and improved.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — DSPM (posture, recommendations, sensitive-data risk) and DSPM for AI (Copilot/AI data-access visibility, sensitive prompts/responses, oversharing controls).
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing, DSPM roles, labels/DLP foundation, Copilot/AI in scope, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — enable DSPM, review posture + act on recommendations, turn on DSPM for AI, assess AI data-access + oversharing, and apply reduction policies (labels/DLP/access) — pilot-first, each action named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (risk surfaced, recommendations actioned, AI oversharing reduced) plus Best Practices for continuous posture improvement; AI-feature availability flagged to verify.
short: Implement Data Security Posture Management (DSPM & DSPM for AI) — surface sensitive-data risk, act on recommendations, and get visibility + controls over what Copilot/AI can access — so data-security posture is measured and improved. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
